scenarios.name: High reflux to hold spec at envelope rate
scenarios.basis: more flow: Column verified at 75.5% flood at 1.1x scale (1.32x original). +30% reflux to 1.95 raises internal L/V directly. Credible operator compensation for purity swing, analyzer bias, or reflux valve overshoot.

scenarios.name: Low column pressure - cold utility/PC drift
scenarios.basis: less pressure: Lowering K2750 from 1.5 to 1.05 bar (-30%) increases vapor specific volume and velocity, raising Fair flood fraction over 0.8 max. Credible winter condenser overcooling, PC offset, or venting.

scenarios.name: Hot feed - preheater overshoot
scenarios.basis: more temperature: Raising FEED from 85 to 110.5C (+30%) increases flashed vapor fraction to column, loading rectifying section. Credible steam preheater control failure, summer heat-integration surge.

scenarios.name: Low feed pressure - upstream pump/filter loss
scenarios.basis: less pressure: Dropping FEED from 3.0 to 2.1 bar (-30%) increases flash across inlet valve, raising vapor feed to K2750. Credible pump wear, strainer fouling, low surge-drum level.

scenarios.name: Light feed swing - ethanol rich
scenarios.basis: composition other than: Ethanol 0.7 to 0.79 with Water 0.3 to 0.21 increases volatile load and rectifying vapor/condenser traffic, pushing flood over 0.8. Credible upstream batch fermentation swing or tank stratification.

scenarios.name: Cold feed - preheater fouling/winter loss
scenarios.basis: less temperature: Subcooling FEED to 59.5C (-30%) quenches vapor, raises internal liquid downflow and stripping load. Credible fouling between cleanings, winter ambient loss, heater bypass/trip.

scenarios.name: Fouled trays compensated with reflux
scenarios.basis: fouling: Efficiency 0.7 to 0.49 (-30%) between cleanings forces operators to raise reflux to 1.95 to hold separation, combined hydraulic load exceeds 0.8 flood. Credible degraded Murphree efficiency response.

scenarios.name: Heavy feed swing - water rich
scenarios.basis: composition other than: Water 0.3 to 0.39 with Ethanol 0.7 to 0.61 increases stripping liquid load and reboiler duty for same split, flooding stripping section. Credible upstream water breakthrough or recycle surge.
